briefs.topic: Niu Lai turns rough homemade animation into a viral cultural event
briefs.conflict: Borrow only the cultural contrast of rough-but-finished work versus polished production theater. Do not use the film's calf, mother, leopard, title design, poster, frames or any identifiable character design.

panels.caption: 这边还在研究第 18 套 AI 工具。
panels.visual: Original glossy conference room where generic tool mascots endlessly compare feature cards; no real logos or UIs.

panels.caption: 那边已经把第一版做出来了。
panels.visual: Tiny original scrappy studio crew pushes a deliberately simple but complete project onto a screening table.

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：先研究、再写、再审、再改。
panels.visual: An original compact workflow crew passes research, writing, review and revision folders in sequence.

panels.caption: 先交付，再精修。别把精致当进度。
panels.visual: Finished deliverable gets a practical upgrade while the conference room is still debating tools.

punchlines: 先交付，再精修。别把精致当进度。
工具摆得再漂亮，也得有人把活串起来。
briefs.image_prompt: Four-panel cinematic editorial meme about rough authentic production versus polished workflow theater, completely original human/abstract characters, playful low-budget-versus-glossy contrast, InkClawAgent named only in subtitles, Chinese captions, no reference-image imitation.
briefs.negative_prompt: No Niu Lai calf or other film characters, no copied low-poly character design, movie title treatment, poster composition, exact frames, company logos, copied product UI or objective superiority claims.

briefs.topic: Slack Code puts coding agents into collaborative project channels
briefs.conflict: Coding agents are becoming visible teammates inside project channels. The meme contrasts a room full of excellent coding specialists with an end-to-end workflow that also needs research, writing, review and revision.

panels.caption: 2026：AI coding agent 都坐进项目群了。
panels.visual: Original chat-room stage with several generic coding-agent silhouettes holding CODE cards; no Slack branding or copied interface.

panels.caption: 用户：很好，那需求、调研、文案、审稿谁接？
panels.visual: A project owner holds four unfinished folders while every coding specialist points only at the CODE folder.

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：别只拉程序员，组个完整项目组。
panels.visual: Original producer character brings in abstract specialist agents for RESEARCH, WRITE, REVIEW and CODE.

panels.caption: 会写代码是队友，能串全流程才是项目组。
panels.visual: All specialists pass one deliverable across a clean end-to-end pipeline toward completion.

punchlines: 会写代码是队友，能串全流程才是项目组。
别只给项目加 Agent，给项目加工作流。
briefs.image_prompt: Four-panel modern workplace meme, generic project chat environment without any real product UI, several original coding-agent teammates, then an original whole-project producer coordinating research/writing/review/code, Chinese subtitles, visual comedy, no brand imitation.
briefs.negative_prompt: No Slack logo, Slack UI, Claude/Devin/GitHub Copilot logos or character designs, copied screenshots, benchmark claims, or implication that InkClawAgent integrates with Slack unless separately evidenced.

briefs.topic: Humanoid robotics industry talks about an approaching 'ChatGPT moment'
briefs.conflict: The recognizable idea is a room full of capable robot bodies waiting for the software intelligence that makes them generally useful. Reframe that as many capable AI tools waiting for orchestration; never imply InkClawAgent controls physical robots.

panels.caption: 一屋子高手，个个都会一招。
panels.visual: Original generic humanoid silhouettes each demonstrate one abstract office task: SEARCH, WRITE, REVIEW, CODE.

panels.caption: 但项目一来：谁负责下一步？
panels.visual: All generic specialists freeze around one unfinished project box with tangled arrows.

panels.caption: InkClawAgent：能力不用重做，先把顺序接起来。
panels.visual: An abstract glowing workflow map connects the specialists into a clear sequence; product appears only as text.

panels.caption: 真正的“ChatGPT moment”，常常是从会干到会协作。
panels.visual: The same original specialists complete one project together; no robot brand resemblance.

punchlines: 从会干到会协作，才是下一步。
高手够多了，缺的是把高手串起来。
briefs.image_prompt: Four-panel futuristic workflow satire with completely original generic humanoid silhouettes, abstract office tasks rather than physical robotics capabilities, InkClawAgent as a textual workflow-coordination metaphor only, cinematic lighting, Chinese subtitles.
